- On the other hand, 'cumulative net gains (losses) on equity securities sold during the period' represents the total net gains or losses that have been recognized after the initial purchase date of the equity security, regardless of the specific period in which they were realized. This includes all recognized gains or losses accumulated up to the point of sale.
Thus, the former focuses on the transaction's immediate financial outcome at the point of sale, while the latter includes the total financial impact over the entire holding period of the security.
